# Consignd DataCore

> Consignd DataCore is a document-intake service for freight brokers. It turns
> rate confirmations, bills of lading (BOLs), proof-of-delivery documents
> (PODs), and carrier invoices — arriving as PDFs, scans, phone photos, email
> bodies, WhatsApp forwards, portal exports, FTP drops, or EDI feeds — into
> clean, source-linked load records, with a human review step on any
> low-confidence field. It works around the broker's existing TMS rather than
> replacing it.

## Who it's for

US freight brokerages and 3PLs, roughly 500–15,000 loads per month, whose
dispatchers and billing teams still rekey document data into a TMS by hand.

## How engagement works (audit-first)

1. The broker sends 25–50 real documents from the last two weeks of operations.
2. Consignd runs a five-day paid Document Audit: classifies every document,
   extracts key fields, maps variation by carrier and type, and reports what
   parses cleanly versus what needs human review.
3. If the workflow proves repeatable, rollout is a one-time setup plus monthly
   managed processing priced by document volume and complexity. If it doesn't,
   the report says so directly.

## Key facts

- Matching is order-independent: a BOL can arrive before its rate con;
  whichever document arrives first seeds the load and later documents match in.
- Unmatched documents go to a triage queue — never dropped or force-matched.
- Every extracted field links back to its source document (provenance).
- Low-confidence fields are routed to a human review queue, never silently guessed.
- Output formats: review queue, CSV, import-ready file, or TMS workflow where
  access allows.
